objective: Compare tied synchronous recurrence with exact topological prefix computation and invalidation.
context: Finite strict-prefix DAG, modular sum recurrence, arbitrary initial state, longest dependency depth, structural descendants. Independent mathematical fixture.

steps.name: Validate prefix graph

steps.name: Compute topological values
